title: streamx
tagline: Decentralized live streaming app built on top of lens protocol and livepeer
description: streamx is a decentralized application built on top of lens protocol and powered by livepeer. The main idea is to have a platform for livestreams(kind of decentralized twitch). Users will be able to create profiles using their wallets. On top of that they have accessibility to attend livestreams or create their own livestreams. Later we'll add features of following other users and probably buy some live streams as NFTs
how_its_made: streamx is built on top of lens protocol to allow users to create profiles from their wallets. Those profiles will be used to identify users on livestreams or in the feed. We have also utilized livepeer to power our streaming platform. Users will be able to livestream by calling api from the livepeer network and devliver best user experience and video experience to viewers
